title: The pricing section headline names the cost of every option
description:
As a visitor on the marketing home page, I want the pricing section headline to say that every option shows its price, so I can read the bill without decoding a riddle.

Out of scope: restyling the pricing cards, changing rung prices, promoting to main.

The riddle "A ladder with a gap where a price should be..." was design rationale leaked onto the page. Replace it with a headline in the homepage voice: two short sentences, then a plain line that every option shows its price.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Feature: Delegation ladder positioning

  Scenario: The pricing section headline names the cost of every option
    Given the chattic.us home page
    When I look at the delegated responsibility section

    And it states that every option shows its price
    And it does not describe a ladder with a gap where a price should be
